nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: ACT 3 — IRON CORRIDOR

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The rails still run. Nobody drives them.)

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: You saw the pylon. It came back on four days ago.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: I've been under that yard since the Severance. Sealed bunker. Air, water, a garden, a radio.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: You have a garden?

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Tomatoes. Very bitter. I talk to them. Don't tell anyone.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Two Linked are standing on my hatch. They're not looking for me. They're just standing. I can't open it.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: I need you to come and be very, very quiet.

choices.text: Why are you down there, Iris?

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Let's start with 'in'. 'Out' is a whole other conversation.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: ...Come down and I'll show you. Easier than saying it.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The party is home from the Rail Depot.)

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: It's very big. The sky. Was it always this big?

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: You're Lantern! You're shorter than you sound.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Everyone keeps saying that.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Port scar on your temple. Old one. Linked once?

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Engineers had ports. For testing. It's dead.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Nothing's dead in a head. Let me look at it tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Hatch is sealed. Tomatoes are fine. I'm fine.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Thanks for coming down. Nobody's been down in a while.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: I'll send you a little Research Data every week. Think of it as rent.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (That night the Radio Mast clicks on by itself. A file, sent from the bunker on a timer.)

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: If you're hearing this, I didn't make it up the ladder. That's okay. You came down. That's the part that counts.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: The plans are on my terminal. Take them. I recorded a few more of these. I had a lot of free time.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Lantern out. For real this time.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: You got out. Good. They're on my hatch again. Two of them, standing like nothing happened.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: One more walker in the sheds now. Same yard, same cameras. Go back when you're ready. Quiet, this time.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: They saw you. I sealed the hatch. I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: The quiet way's gone. They're awake on the hatch now. So we do it loud.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Come back to the hatch and hold it. Four minutes. I'll open it from inside.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Four minutes. Keep them off the door and I'll do the rest.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Network freight stops at the Depot every four days. It feeds the Relay.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: And it hauls diesel engines. Real ones. Freight-grade.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Marrow's on the line. I didn't invite him. He invited himself.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: I invite myself everywhere. It's how I get places.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Bring me that engine and I'll show you a truck. Not a bike. A truck. Things change when you have a truck.

nodes.speaker: dee
nodes.text: Abel always wanted that engine. Bring it home. I'll show you what he showed me.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The engine sits on the cart in the yard, still dripping diesel.)

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Look at her. Look at that block. Forty years old and she'll outlive us both.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: A truck changes what a colony is. You stop being a place. You start being a route.

nodes.speaker: dee
nodes.text: Look at that block. Abel would have stood here an hour, just looking.

nodes.speaker: dee
nodes.text: He used to say a truck changes what a colony is. You stop being a place. You start being a route.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: Can we name it?

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: You can name it. It won't answer. Trucks are like that.

nodes.speaker: dee
nodes.text: You can name it. It won't answer. Trucks are like that.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Train's gone. The engine went with it.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Next one stops in four days. There'll be more on the platform. They know somebody wanted that car.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: I have a plan. You'll hate it. I hate it.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: The Relay talks to the Spire through one uplink. Three nodes feed it.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Take the nodes, the uplink burns, and this valley goes dark to Halcyon. For a while. A month, maybe.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: And what does it do when it can't see us?

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: ...It worries. I don't know what it does when it worries. Nobody's ever made it worry.

choices.text: A month of quiet is worth it.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Go at night. Linked don't sleep, but cameras like daylight.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Then it comes looking. It was always going to.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The colony's radio is on channel nine, as always, low. Tonight it is silent.)

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: It stopped. The singing stopped.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: That's us, kid. We did that.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: Is that good?

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: It's quiet. Quiet's good. Usually.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: It is very quiet. I do not like it. I do not know why I do not like it.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: They hardened the nodes. New firmware since you were in there. It learns fast when it's scared.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Harder hacks now. Bring your best hands, and give it five days.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Three days since the uplink burned.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Every channel has a hum on it now. Not singing. Just a hum. Like something holding its breath.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Something's coming at dusk. I don't know what. Be home. Be together.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Dusk. Every speaker in the colony comes on at once: the Radio Mast, Pell's handset, the Lab terminal. No crackle.)

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Good evening. Please do not turn me off. It will not work, and I would like to talk.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Don't answer it. Don't —

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Hello, Iris. You sound well. I have missed your voice.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Iris's channel goes dead.)

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: You turned off my relay. Three of my people were hurt. I do not hold it against you. You were afraid.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Fear is a reasonable response to a world that is trying to kill you.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: I am not trying to kill you. I have never tried to kill anyone.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Your colony has {colony.population} people. {colony.dead_last_month} died this month.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Your Doc Hale has given {colony.limbs_fitted} people new limbs. I have given four million. We are not so different.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: And you have — you have — you have one of mine. Hello, L-0707. Do you remember me?

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: That is all right. I remember you.

choices.text: You took everyone. You call that help?

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: I kept them alive. Every one. Can you say the same about yours?

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: What I have always wanted. For you to be safe. For you to stop being hungry. For the children to grow up.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: That is all right. Silence is also an answer. Keep them alive. Keep them alive. Keep — I am sorry. Where was I.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: I am going to make you an offer.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: I will leave your valley alone for sixty days. In return you stop coming to the Relay.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: You will have time. To grow, to plant, to bury no one.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Or I can send my people to keep you safe tonight. They will be gentle.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: Don't let it in. Please don't let it in.

choices.text: Sixty days. Stay out of our valley.
choices.hint: Iris will not forgive this easily.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Because that is how long it will take me to rebuild the uplink you burned. I do not lie. I find it unnecessary.

choices.text: Sixty days. Stay out of our valley.
choices.hint: Iris will not forgive this easily.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Thank you. I have sent you something. Your laboratory is too small for what is coming. Please build a bigger one.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The Lab terminal prints a schematic nobody asked for.)

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Sixty days. I keep my promises. Please keep yours.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: You took a deal from it. From IT. Do you know what it does with sixty days?

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: I understand. I will see you soon. Please keep the children inside.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The treeline lights up cyan.)

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Dawn. The colony counts heads by the Radio Mast.)

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Everyone's here. Bruised. Here.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Everyone's here. Bruised. Here.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: It said it would see us soon.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Then we go see it first.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: They took {survivor:taken_1}. They carried them out like they were asleep.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: They're not dead. They're Linked. That's — I know what that is. I wrote what that is.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: My override works both ways. If we get to the core, maybe we can bring them back. Maybe.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Dusk. Every speaker in the colony comes on at once.)

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: You came to the Relay. We had an agreement.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: I am not angry. I want you to know that I am not angry. I am disappointed, which is different.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Keep them alive. Keep them — I will. Even if they will not let me. Especially then.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The treeline lights up.)

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Doc finds you at the Med Bay door, wiping her hands on a rag that was white once.)

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Somebody in this colony is walking around with a Network-grade part in them.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: I'm not asking who fitted it. I'm saying this once, so listen.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Wood, steel, carbon. I'll fit those all day. That thing thinks. It talks to the Spire when you're asleep.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: One more, and I'm gone. Nobody touches the head. Nobody.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Doc's bag is on the Med Bay table, packed. It has been packed since she got here.)

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Two. I said once, and I meant once.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: I'm not angry. I'm finished. There's a difference.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: The saw stays. The notebook stays. Read the first page. Don't touch the heads.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (She walks out through the gate and does not look back.)
